scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof plus standalone finite tests. Finite tests corroborate but do not replace proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The width-one conclusion requires a field splitting all characters of the finite abelian group of odd order. Nonsplitting fields, modular characteristics dividing the group order, and even-order groups are not covered. Prior Fourier techniques are acknowledged; historical-priority risk remains.
title: Single-commutator theorem for split odd-order core-quandle algebras
